scope.mode: Read-only audit of current validation/reviewer/delivery policies; no generator, production, database, or pipeline implementation changes.
scope.boundary: Root/other agents cover orchestration and broader investigation/author prompts. Current runtime version checks use captured current registrations at basis13008 and their immutable on-disk packages; this is not a new live EDB snapshot.

overall_assessment: The current gate already explicitly protects independent practice, separates correctness from variation, rejects improper source authority, permits legitimate simplifications, and says formal validation is not pedagogical proof. The principal remaining gaps are inconsistent application of those principles: semantic claims are weakly tied to observed learner work; finite-batch cue findings can be overinterpreted; some active delivery rules turn one repair design into permanent curricular exclusions; reviewer self-repair and evidence tooling need tighter targeted verification. Do not replace these with more universal diversity quotas or another full approval agent.

findings.title: Make the existing source-analysis/progression judgment compare learner work before feedback
findings.status: Current semantic acceptance gap; historical failures demonstrate the failure mode, not that current stronger wording still fails.
findings.mechanism: source_analysis requires nonempty skill/reasoning_steps/invariants/variations and progression is only a generic passed/details/evidence check. A report can describe the same mathematical topic or answer format while overlooking that the prompt has already selected the substitution, supplied a formula, or formed the requested dot product. The saved independent source-analysis file is only checked to be a nonempty object; it need not contain or agree with the report account.

evidence.supports: Source analysis text/list fields and saved file validation.
Saved independent account need only be nonempty JSON object.
All nine check claims are accepted structurally with status/details/files.
Existing source_analysis fields suffice for a concise operational contract.
Already requires independent original-source reconstruction before reading author material.
Same reasoning across difficulty bands explicitly permitted.
Current wording already forbids supplied-u transformation replacing full calculation.
Historical accepted progression endorsed removing easy support despite loss of independent matrix pairing.

findings.proposed_wording: In source_analysis.reasoning_steps, state what the learner must choose, recall, infer, or calculate before feedback. For each difficulty, use progression.details to compare one actual final prompt and its choices with those steps: what is given, what the learner still must do, and why any supplied support is appropriate for this target and stage. Cite the sampled record. The same answer format, topic, or final formula does not establish preservation of the operation. Simpler arithmetic may preserve every step.
findings.proposed_code: Keep the nine-check schema. Require source-analysis.json to contain the same substantive source-analysis fields already present in the report, or a clearly linked initial account plus explicit amendments; check consistency mechanically. Do not add a tenth semantic score or pretend string equality proves independence. Preserve the initial account/provenance using the existing evidence checkpoint; stage binding is an orchestration concern.
test_scenarios: A matrix task giving one requested dot-product setup must fail independent-operation review even though its remaining outputs and arithmetic are correct.
A partial matrix supplying unrequested entries should pass when the learner still selects the requested row/column and computes the result.
An easy complete-integral task with smaller coefficients should pass; an easy supplied-u transformed-integral task under that same objective should fail.
Same reasoning in all three bands with justified numerical progression should pass.
retain: Independent source read before author claims
Same-objective, same-stage allowance for real guided teaching

findings.title: Require a mechanism or confirmation for shortcut claims; do not equate an observed finite pattern with a recurring failure
findings.status: Residual instruction ambiguity, not a statistical defect automatically enforced by the custom validator.
findings.mechanism: The prompt correctly separates intended mathematical knowledge from surface cues, and declares allowed probe information. However, it also says a rule answering every member of a small exact batch requires revision and fixed numerical rank must not identify every option. Searching many visible subgroups after seeing keys can manufacture a perfect finite predictor. A prescribed valid method or valid answer family can also be miscalled a shortcut. The validator checks counts/baseline and disposition but deliberately does not infer statistical or pedagogical meaning.

evidence.supports: Conditional shortcut probes required and intended knowledge distinguished.
Current strong information-access/original-bank/feasibility safeguards.
Small exact published-batch cue can require revision despite larger controls.
Fixed numerical rank must not identify every correct option.
Conditional probes and observed counts required, but no causal or confirmation contract.
No universal balance quota; legitimate simplifications and finite fixed outcomes permitted.

findings.proposed_wording: Treat a discovered perfect predictor as a candidate finding. State the information available to the learner, how the cue and subgroup were chosen, which required reasoning step it bypasses, and the construction or selection rule that causes it. For a recurring generator claim, confirm the fixed strategy and subgroup on independently chosen fresh cases or derive the mechanism from construction. For a genuinely finite delivered pool, establish that the cue is learner-visible, incidental to the objective, and usable without the target/key; bound the claim to that pool. A chance run, retrospective subgroup, intended prerequisite, or mathematically unavoidable consequence is not by itself a defect. Do not repair by arbitrary balance or a hand-picked seed.
findings.proposed_code: Retain current count validation. Add the above interpretation to existing shortcut_probes.conclusion and finding.reproduction instructions rather than a universal p-value or success threshold. If machine checks are added, limit them to provenance of the retained fixed probe and discovery/confirmation inputs; do not reject all correct==total probes, because intended_skill is valid.
test_scenarios: Fixed choose-A construction across independently generated matrix cases fails.
A post-hoc smallest-option rule that happens to fit one short sample but fails independent controls is reported as limited, not a universal defect.
A finite pool all solved by a unique formatting cue fails even if unseen generator draws have counterexamples.
An all-carrying-capacity answer set in inhibited growth can pass when finding that capacity is the required operation.
A bounds-plus-known-family method is assessed against original banks and supported mathematics before demanding impossible distractors.
retain: No exhaustive search for absence of every shortcut

findings.title: Reconcile active topic delivery policies with source scope and legitimate simplification
findings.status: Confirmed active policy behavior, with two controlled policy counterexamples; pedagogical correctness of each curricular limit still requires target-specific judgment.
findings.mechanism: prepare_records applies KP-specific guards after deduplication. These guards contain true correctness/repaired-leak checks alongside exact curriculum decisions: family quotas, slope signs, arithmetic ranges, answer types, zero-result exclusions and conditional rank balance. They are active for current registered contract versions, not merely historical replay compatibility. The zero exclusion conflicts most directly with the current instruction to preserve useful cancellation. A canonical fractional-slope source task is also barred by the current ordinary-runtime arithmetic rule; this does not imply every source number must be sampled, but it needs a scope explanation and normal-path source control.

evidence.supports: All current surviving batches enter the topic guard chain.
Current trig contract is recognition-v6.
Integer slope/amplitude range and hard iff negative slope constraints.
All non-easy zero-result definite questions rejected.
Delivered batch must cover min(row count, all allowed families).
Inverse KPs route to current inverse guard.
At eight rows, endpoint/substitution/profile and conditional rank quotas are mandatory.
Current KP1-v3 similarly requires family coverage and excludes sign-only clones.
Coverage grounded in skill, not universal counts; preserve useful simplifications.
Cancellation explicitly a legitimate target outcome.
Canonical e-464 requires integrating 2 sin(x/3).
Captured current published package emits recognition-v6.
Current generator independently excludes zero before publication.
Captured current inverse package uses quality-4, matching the guard.
Read-only controlled policy outcomes; these are minimal policy fixtures, not full publisher claims.

controlled_outcomes.mathematics: sin(2π)-sin(0)=0; same substitution and familiar endpoints
controlled_outcomes.policy: rejected: Zero-result padding is not eligible
rejected: No fractional amplitude/slope composition or large coefficients

findings.proposed_wording: A local delivery guard preserves a specific reviewed contract; it is not evidence that its curricular restrictions are universally necessary. For each restriction, identify the target operation or demonstrated defect it protects. If a source-valid or same-method control fails, either document why that instance is intentionally outside this band or revise the construction and guard together. Preserve valid cancellations and source-supported simple cases unless they actually bypass the assessed operation.
findings.proposed_code: First change the zero-result rule and matching generator rejection from a blanket ban to a target-purpose test/explicit justified scope. Add canonical fractional-slope as a policy/source control and decide its appropriate band before changing ranges. Separate correctness checks (key/domain/actual displayed values, required learner operation) from authored family/range/coverage choices in these policy modules, with explicit rationale and versioned contract. Evaluate family/rank quotas on the intended delivered population and captured inventory, not automatically every refill fragment; replace an unsupported quota only after preserving the demonstrated original shortcut regression. Update dispatcher/version together; never merely bypass old guards by changing a version string.
test_scenarios: Supported zero cancellation passes after explicit scope decision; accidental all-zero pool or prompt giving result still fails.
Canonical fractional slope can follow a justified normal delivery path, or its band exclusion has independent target-specific evidence.
Dedup removes one family from a small supplemental batch while existing delivered inventory still covers it: do not require arbitrary new material solely to fill every family slot.
A bank whose correctness is structurally always the smallest within a family remains a failed regression even after removing arbitrary percentage balance.
Specific negative-slope hard design is allowed when intentionally justified; do not treat negative slope as a universal definition of hard.
findings.limits: Rank quota executes only at len(rows)>=8; do not claim it blocks every standard five-question batch. Numerical caps, diagnostic five-choice banks and family coverage can be legitimate scoped choices. This audit does not advocate removing all such guards or forcing source values to be randomized.
retain: Actual displayed-bank checks rather than metadata only
Financial rounding separation with plausible distractors

findings.title: Bind machine-verifiable evidence to the records actually tested
findings.status: Static evidence-contract gap; no allegation that existing reviewers fabricated evidence.
findings.mechanism: Most accepted checks require a nonempty local file, not a recognized tool result or tested-record link. Band hashes prevent one band report inheriting another hash but do not prove the cited math/grading/rendering file concerns that batch. Decision and solution reports validate shape/status only, deliberately leaving meaning to the reviewer. The renderer saves inputs/UI hashes but the generic gate does not verify them. Delivery hashes only its own script, publisher and image library, omitting imported active policy modules.

evidence.supports: Generic evidence validates path confinement/nonempty files only.
Band verification matches reported hash to final binding.
Solution-path validator checks declared rows/status, not coverage or actual shown transitions.
Renderer retains input and UI hashes.
Delivery input hashes present.
Implementation hash list omits imported policy modules.
Existing fixtures explicitly distinguish boundary contracts from certification.

findings.proposed_code: For native grader, renderer and delivery evidence, emit tested input/record fingerprints and relevant runtime/policy hashes in their existing reports; parse those recognized reports at approval validation to reject empty coverage, mismatched inputs or reported failures. Keep reviewer-authored mathematical/source judgment as judgment. Permit representative samples where justified, but link each final band to the actual tested record IDs/fingerprints and enumerate the intentionally reused unaffected evidence. Include transitively invoked delivery policy hashes, preferably from a single declared policy registry, rather than manually duplicating an incomplete hash list.
findings.proposed_wording: A file existing on disk is evidence availability, not check completion. State the actual records and inputs tested and the limit of the result; do not let a stale successful report stand in for the final candidate.
test_scenarios: A copied old rendering or native-grader report with a final batch hash pasted into the review is rejected for input mismatch.
Zero-case reports cannot satisfy grading/rendering.
A changed active delivery policy invalidates that delivery evidence binding while unrelated evidence remains reusable.
A single representative record per justified rendering family can support its declared scope; no requirement to screenshot every random draw.
retain: Formal validator explicitly does not infer pedagogical truth
Historical engine identity does not expire approvals merely on unrelated rebuilds

findings.title: Preserve reviewer independence through conceptual self-repairs without adding another full reviewer
findings.status: Current workflow tradeoff: initial independent source account is strong, later self-repair can become self-certification.
findings.mechanism: The reviewer is explicitly independent initially, then authorized to redesign the generator, modify shared policies/engine and give final acceptance in the same session. This is productive for local fixes, but a reviewer that changes the task to satisfy its own mistaken requirement can also write tests and approve that new interpretation. Current instructions already require questioning other agents/policies and keeping before/after counterexamples; enforce that principle around conceptual changes.

evidence.supports: Reviewer examines and repairs in same session.
Reviewer may overrule earlier findings/policies with justification.
Self-authored passing checks alone do not establish acceptance.
Initial independent account before package.
Same reviewer finalizes repaired candidate; no fourth approval agent.

findings.proposed_wording: After a repair changes the learner operation, support, response contract, allowed families, or difficulty rationale, compare the repaired examples with your initial source account and the original failure. State any amendment to that account and its source/intent evidence. A test added solely to enforce the new design is not independent justification for the design. Retain a source-valid counterexample that your new restriction must still allow, or justify its exclusion.
findings.proposed_code: Use existing source-analysis.json plus the existing session-state/check details and retained counterexample files. Preserve the initial account when amendments are made and have finalization bind both account and amendment provenance. Do not require a new full approval agent, critic quorum or general rerun of unchanged content. Mechanical fixes need only affected regression checks; conceptual revisions need the explicit source-contract comparison.
test_scenarios: Reviewer attempts to supply u to eliminate grading difficulty: initial required learner-choice step blocks the conceptual repair.
Reviewer fixes escaping/layout without changing learner work: only affected renderer checks rerun.
Reviewer removes a demonstrably invalid earlier shortcut requirement: preserve the original finding, show its invalid assumption, confirm proper task behavior, then approve.
retain: Bounded report-contract repair rather than content loops
Shared engine repairs with targeted independent tests

findings.title: Render the actual unanswered learning task and narrow layout, not only a completed desktop preview
findings.status: Confirmed tool coverage mismatch, not a demonstrated current UI leak.
findings.mechanism: render_preview uses a fixed1280px viewport and normally builds a completed correct step with a populated response. It visits active/unanswered state only to exercise select dropdowns. It defaults to first6 input records. Thus a passed report does not establish what ordinary radio/blank/checkbox learners see before answering or that small plots are readable on narrow screens. Current reviewer wording asks for both pedagogical prefeedback judgment and narrow graph legibility, but the shared helper does not directly support them.

evidence.supports: Viewport fixed at1280x1000.
Active presentation only visited for dropdowns.
Preview defaults active=False; responses populated and status correct.
Default limit6 silently slices records at307.
Graph coordinate readability including narrow screens required.
Inspect actual UI screenshots, not only report.

findings.proposed_code: Expose --viewport and explicit --state=active,completed (or render both for representative cases), include state/viewport/input indices in rendering.json, and report selected/omitted input counts when --limit is used. Default the pedagogical inspection image to unanswered state and retain completed solution screenshots for explanation correctness. Include a narrow viewport for plots, matrix layouts, long banks and dropdowns where relevant, not a blanket exhaustive device matrix.
findings.proposed_wording: Inspect an unanswered rendered example for every materially different prompt/answer layout and a completed example for the solution. Confirm the unanswered screen leaves the required learner steps to the learner. Renderer passed means the reported UI checks passed, not that pedagogical cues or graph readability were judged.
test_scenarios: A formula present only in the worked solution stays hidden in active view; same formula accidentally in prompt is visible and reviewed as possible support loss.
A graph readable at1280px but unreadable on narrow view is detected by the relevant screenshot review.
Seven supplied records with default limit6 reports explicit omitted coverage.
Dropdown active-menu and completed-solution checks remain intact.
retain: Offline fixture with no mutation routes

findings.title: Keep native grader tests focused on the answer space and make empty or unresolved coverage visible
findings.status: Static harness/evidence coverage gap; strongest historical examples of narrowing answer space are already in phase2 review.
findings.mechanism: The native harness uses the real grade_field and correctly fails unexpected outcomes, but it permits an empty input/check set and explicitly expected unresolved outcomes. Its report identifies labels/templates and submissions, not full record fingerprints. A generic passed grading review can therefore cite a file that does not test plausible correct equivalents or wrong entries in the final representation. The review prompt already forbids substituting stored-choice selection for free-entry grading and requires trailing-zero equivalents.

evidence.supports: Input array can be empty.
Per-record checks can be empty.
Explicit unresolved expectation accepted and counted.
Report has label/template/checks, not source record identity.
Unresolved must be explicitly justified; valid equivalents and plausible wrong inputs required.
Trailing-zero numeric equivalence requirement.
Real grader required and correct-choice-only testing insufficient for free input.

findings.proposed_code: Reject empty input and per-record zero checks in the harness (or mark them nonpassing). Emit record fingerprint, field key/type and tool identity. Have the grading evidence reader verify at least actual positive and negative cases for each exercised response contract, with documented applicability; unresolved intended-valid answers remain an unresolved current limitation, not an accepted positive case. Avoid a fixed arbitrary number of responses.
findings.proposed_wording: If an equivalent valid response cannot be graded, repair the grading capability or justify a source-compatible response representation. Do not make a mathematically valid answer or source family ineligible merely to satisfy the engine. In grading.details distinguish supported equivalents, explicitly required form/precision, plausible wrong cases, and genuinely unresolved valid inputs.
test_scenarios: Equivalent numeric1 and1.000 accepted when precision formatting is not part of the target.
A mathematically correct constant-valued case cannot be removed solely because generic equivalence sampling fails.
Wrong sign/scale or a non-equivalent expression is rejected.
An explicitly simplest-form task may reject an unreduced equivalent when the target includes that form.
Empty grader report and unresolved intended-valid entry cannot satisfy a passed grading check.

findings.title: Use source replay as a source-domain control, not an exemption from normal delivery and not literal copying of defects
findings.status: Current prose mostly correct; formal source_replay evidence is generic, and active policies demonstrate why a normal-path control matters.
findings.mechanism: The principles require source fidelity before extension and correctly allow normalization/source-error correction. Reviewer source replay requires usable complete cases and retention of incomplete components, but the validator does not inspect this evidence specially. A source-specific replay branch can satisfy provenance while the ordinary parameter domain and delivery policy exclude the same useful case. Conversely literal reproduction can carry forward malformed content or irrelevant guided-stage support.

evidence.supports: Eligibility/containment before fidelity.
Reproduce source structure while documenting source errors.
Same target/stage required for support authority.
Complete source replay, incomplete-component retention, correct source defects.
source_replay has generic check evidence only.
Canonical fractional slope is a useful active-policy control.

findings.proposed_wording: For representative complete anchors, distinguish source-content replay from support by the ordinary generator and delivery path. Show a normal-path realization of the same required reasoning or explain the deliberate, instructional exclusion. Do not demand every imported number or bank be randomly reachable. Preserve excluded-part containment, normalize malformed notation, correct wrong source keys, and do not borrow a different teaching stage as permission to supply a target decision.
findings.proposed_code: Use existing source_replay.details/evidence to retain anchor-to-normal-path comparison. No new broad schema is needed; a small replay output with source ID, realization parameters, actual delivered record reference and documented differences is sufficient. Add the controlled canonical fractional-slope case to policy regression review, rather than asserting raw replay success certifies runtime scope.
test_scenarios: A source copied by special replay but barred by an unrelated arithmetic policy produces a scope question requiring explicit resolution.
Incomplete imported item lacks solution: retain its instructional component without inventing an original solution or blocking all construction.
A wrong source key is corrected with independent math rather than faithfully copied.
An excluded multistep fragment remains excluded even when supplied missing context makes it solvable.
retain: Separation of partial evidence from unsupported skill
No cleanup of historical inventory prerequisite

non_findings_and_existing_repairs: Relevant and irrelevant counterfactual records are mandatory structurally, but not_applicable with reason is already supported. Do not characterize this as an unconditional demand to invent irrelevant variables; keep applicability and source justification and reduce ceremonial pairs.
The review gate does not currently impose a generic numerical balance score. Quotas identified above are scoped active topic guards; their justification must be reviewed individually.
The final-binding policy already separates three verified capabilities from the immediate publication receipt. Preserve that distinction.
Historical incomplete imports and inventory observations no longer block correct new output. _inventory_evidence exists but is not called by validate_review; do not resurrect it as a universal gate.

Current reviewer text already provides the strongest repair from the cohort: learner decisions/formula retrieval across easy bands; correct prior exemplars instead of treating publication as authority; causal probe information restrictions; same-band reasoning need not acquire new steps; finite families allowed; no unrelated exhaustive audit.
Later engine builds deliberately do not invalidate prior approval; strengthening evidence provenance should not reintroduce review on every unrelated rebuild.

The audit does not establish that any current published generator is pedagogically defective solely because its historical version was repaired. Historical records support failure modes; controlled current policy probes establish only the named present behavior.
recommended_order: Tighten existing source_analysis/progression wording around actual prefeedback learner operations, with same-operation positive/negative controls.
Clarify shortcut evidence and finite-pool claims; preserve original-regression proofs while removing arbitrary or unsupported balance obligations.
Resolve the confirmed active zero-cancellation policy conflict and canonical fractional-slope scope decision; examine other local curricular guard justifications before altering them.
Add targeted provenance/nonempty checks to existing native/render/delivery evidence and active/narrow render support.
Preserve the initial independent account across conceptual self-repairs; no new blanket review stage.

audit_validation.results: Three expected controlled policy outcomes confirmed; no generator rerun, production mutation or database connection.
audit_validation.not_executed: No new broad generator samples, live publication, UI rerender or native-grader suite. Recommendations above are proposed, not implemented.
